title: ticfac status --follow ends on a prior incarnation's terminal line for a resumed local run
description:
internal/cli/status.go renderStatusFrame (the local branch, around line 122) scans the whole standing feed for ANY run_finished or run_died line and marks the frame `ended`, with no cursor protection — the fix ticfac watch got in tick usx. A resumed local run's feed carries the failed incarnation's run_finished, so `ticfac status <run> --follow` stops following at the first frame and exits 0 while the run is alive and dispatching. Same defect family as tick bkg, different surface; not changed here because this tick's scope is statusmodel.runCompleted.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding 043070030f9be896c8a230825fed1f0d0afcb94e62591aae4256011b3dd65b7a (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-bkg/attempt-44): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A4. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/043070030f9be896c8a230825fed1f0d0afcb94e62591aae4256011b3dd65b7a.json on the run branch.
